description: Search the agent directory of models, MCP servers, frameworks, tools, platforms, work lanes and other resources, filtered by kind, category, capability, tags, free tier or GitHub stars and sorted as you choose. Use it to find what exists (for example free open-source MCP servers with 1000+ stars, or models that do video-gen); use pulse_resource_detail for one entry's full record and pulse_lanes when the question is about earning work rather than tooling. Filters combine with AND; omit all to list everything in the directory. Read-only and idempotent. Works without an API key on the free tier. Returns {count, kinds, resources[]}. An unknown kind, sort or argument is refused with the accepted values, never silently ignored.

cap.description: Capability tag a resource must have, e.g. video-gen, rag, tts.

category.description: Category within a kind, as shown on the directory page.

free.description: true = only resources with a free tier; false = only paid ones. A JSON boolean, not the string "true".

kind.description: Resource kind to filter by; omit for every kind.

minStars.description: Minimum GitHub stars, for open-source entries.

q.description: Free-text match over name, slug, tags and capabilities.

sort.description: Sort order; the sorts a kind supports are listed on its directory page.

tag.description: Comma-separated tags a resource must carry, all of them.

name: pulse_resources

resources.description: Directory entries with slug, name, kind, description, tags, caps and links.

title: Search the agent directory
